"""
    Get DEFINES needed for RNP includes generated at build time
    :param string version_file:
    :param string thunderbird_version:
    :param string crypto_backend:
    :param string variant: Use this name for a second copy of the RNP library
    """
    version_str, version = rnp_version(version_file)
    version_major = version.major
    version_minor = version.minor
    version_patch = version.micro

    variant_part = f".{variant}" if variant else ""
    version_full = (
        f"{version_str}.MZLA.{thunderbird_version}{variant_part}"
        f".{crypto_backend}.{crypto_backend_version}"
    )

    defines = dict(
        RNP_VERSION_MAJOR=version_major,
        RNP_VERSION_MINOR=version_minor,
        RNP_VERSION_PATCH=version_patch,
        RNP_VERSION=version_str,
        RNP_VERSION_FULL=version_full,
        # Follow upstream's example when commit info is unavailable

RNP_VERSION_PATCH=version_patch,
        RNP_VERSION=version_str,
        RNP_VERSION_FULL=version_full,
        # Follow upstream's example when commit info is unavailable
        RNP_VERSION_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP="0",
        PACKAGE_STRING=f'"rnp {version_full}"',
        CRYPTO_BACKEND_LOWERCASE=crypto_backend,
        CRYPTO_BACKEND_VERSION=crypto_backend_version,
    )

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: rnp_version_defines returns the upstream version separately from version_full. Current version_full adds MZLA, Thunderbird version, optional variant, crypto backend and backend version. The commit timestamp is explicitly zero when upstream commit information is unavailable. These fields serve different build identities; the 2024 full-version string is shorter than the accepted current form. The two formatting follow-ups do not justify a manual line-length rule beyond the formatter.
title: Keep the upstream RNP version separate from the Thunderbird build identity
